name: Reading & Film Journal
description: Log the books you read and films you watch: works and each experience are kept apart, with a yearly review by actual finish date
help: Work details (title, author or director, year, genre, tags, total pages or minutes) are kept apart from each reading or viewing. Same-name works and editions stay separate and are never merged automatically.
Press Start to add an experience; rereading or rewatching adds another one, keeping earlier experiences and reviews. Editing a work never changes any review.

An experience records the start date, pages read or minutes watched, a rating and a short review. With an unknown total only the current progress is shown, never a percentage; progress cannot exceed a known total.

Progress and completion are separate: reaching the last page does not mark it finished; press Finish. The finish date may be left empty and filled in later under Missing dates; it cannot be before the start date or after today.

Filter by type, status, tag and rating; search also looks through your reviews. The yearly review counts only actual finish dates, with works and completions counted separately (a reread in the same year is 1 work, 2 completions); entries without a finish date are left out.
Undo reverts the latest step. Delete a work's experiences before deleting the work. Covers are your own pictures only; otherwise a text card is shown.

Export CSV or a full JSON backup. Restoring with Append skips works and experiences whose ids already exist, so restoring the same backup twice never double counts; Replace all asks for confirmation. All data stays in ToolForge on this device.
